RESIDENTIAL TENANCY AGREEMENT (STANDARD FORM OF LEASE)

1. PARTIES. Landlord: Maple Ridge Rentals. Tenant: Jordan Sample.

2. RENTAL UNIT. 45 Sample Avenue, Unit 3, Peterborough, Ontario.

3. TERM. The tenancy starts on September 1, 2026 and is for a fixed term of one year.

4. RENT. Rent is $1,150 per month, paid on the first day of each month by e-transfer.

5. DEPOSITS. The Tenant will pay a rent deposit equal to one month's rent, to be applied to the last month of the tenancy. A refundable key deposit of $40 applies.

6. UTILITIES. Landlord pays heat and water. Tenant pays electricity.

7. MAINTENANCE. The Landlord will keep the unit in a good state of repair. The Tenant will keep the unit reasonably clean and repair damage they or their guests cause.

8. SMOKING. Smoking is not permitted inside the unit.

Signed: ____________________   Date: ____________
